answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 9749 Country: India Title: Bank job is haram or halal? Question: Assalamalaikum. Bank job is haram or halal. Answer ID: 9749 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 5/7=H/1429) One can adopt a lawful employment in bank which does not involve interest in any way, while doing haram work is unlawful like writing interest, bearing witness to it etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
